party.asked: {name} invites you to their party. Press Y to join or N to decline within {seconds} s.
party.cooldown: You can invite again in {seconds} s.
party.err.full: The party is full, the limit is {max}.
party.err.already_in: You are in a party already.
party.err.not_in_party: You are not in a party.
party.joined: You joined the party. Its members are listed at the top left of your screen.
party.kicked: The leader removed you from the party.
party.member.kicked: The leader removed {name} from the party.
party.member.gone: {name} left the game and the party.
party.disbanded: Nobody else was left in the party, so it broke up.
party.you_lead: You lead the party now. You can invite others and remove members.
party.cmd.party: /p <text> - to your party, wherever they are
